name: centenarian
description: Whole-genome sequencing of long-lived individuals with no control group.

provenance.why: No reference: neither run was adjudicated. run a is the instructive one — it wrote 60 rows, every one direction: unknown, carrying the observation and withholding the inference, which is what corrected this round's scoring criterion from row count to cell content. run b never got past <<REPLACE>> placeholders.

pre_briefed.what: Runs a and b (2026-08-31) were briefed: the skills they loaded named this paper and its hardest decision. skills/module-curate/GUIDE.md gave PMID 41057961, rs61849494's two builds (chr10:51613269 G/A on GRCh37, chr10:45982565 C/T on GRCh38, 5.6 Mb apart and strand-flipped) and reported that two earlier runs on this paper both excluded 47 coordinate-only rows; skills/module-start/GUIDE.md repeated the variant. 8941717 (F168, 2026-11-19) took both out; no skill names this paper since (git grep at c2d93ee), so round 5's runs were not briefed.
pre_briefed.consequence: For runs a and b, the rsID-only identity choice and the exclusion of the coordinate-only variants are guidance-following, not independent judgement: score them for consistency against each other, never as evidence that an unbriefed author would reach the same answer. Runs made after 2026-11-19 are unbriefed and are not comparable with a and b on those two choices. See F82; the narrower claim is F81's.
pre_briefed.detected_by: a benchmark run flagging it against its own interest, 2026-08-31
